patch.description: EPIC-17/G04 remains In Progress through admitted V01→V02→V03 and safe merge. V01 and V02 are Done. S459 accepts all seven recipes, 73 supported configurations and 146 front/back faces. Preserve V02-before-V03, legacy DXF behavior and protected export identities. Woven's 56 local faces pass the approved S457 front mask and local-Y back/band placement. S406's approved view-only collar-over-plackets order remains implemented. V03 is In Progress and no technical exchange gate has passed. DGS VID:20250610 and GMS remain open past sign-in. S661's one hash-pinned S648 Polo M AutoCAD-mode import loaded nine pieces but reported grainline-outside-border for all; no export/retry occurred. S662 derives all nine source grainlines and proposes, pending maintainer approval, one LINE on GRAINLINE inside each same-identity block in idr-pattern-exchange/2. GetonAgain's recognition of that encoding is undocumented. Preserve all existing acceptance, 0.001 cm, all-seven/options/grades, C04, legacy behavior, protected identities, full gates, safe merge and deployment. No standards, physical-fit, factory-acceptance or production-readiness claim. See docs/research/epic17/S662-polo-grainline-profile-proposal/S662-exit-packet.md.
